title: CSM orchestrate request envelope
description: Immutable driver intake request for the csm-orchestrate skill taxonomy. Declares a single verb (kind) over the routeable skills, the canonical run identity consumed for lease/evidence dirs and handoff identity, and bounded optional routing hints (artifactRef, repo, constraints, requestedSignals). The request envelope is never self-routeable to csm-orchestrate.

requestId.description: Non-empty identifier for this request; runId (not requestId) is the canonical identity consumed by lease/evidence dirs and handoff.

kind.description: Skill-taxonomy verb the request routes on; csm-orchestrate has no self-route.

prompt.description: Free-text instruction that activates the routed skill.

goalSlug.description: Canonical worktree goal slug (matches wt-session SLUG_RE); feeds worktree/dir naming.

artifactRef.description: Optional reference to a prior artifact (e.g. a saved plan or approach) the routed skill should consume.

repo.description: Optional repository path or identifier the request targets; absent when the request is repo-agnostic.

constraints.description: Optional bounded constraints narrowing the routed skill's execution.

requestedSignals.description: Optional explicit-mode routing hints; a skill named here is selected even when its activation mode is explicit-only.
